headline: Man scammed of Rs 27 lakh for govt job
summary: A man's attempt to secure a government job by paying Rs 27 lakh has resulted in a fraud case and legal action in Goa. The incident highlights ongoing scams involving false job promises in the state.

headline: Goa CM vows strict action in fake excise job scam
summary: Goa Chief Minister Pramod Sawant has assured that strict legal action will be taken against individuals involved in the recent fake excise job scam. The government is cracking down on fraudulent recruitment rackets.

headline: Two FIRs filed against Taleigao man in job scam
summary: Goa police have registered two separate First Information Reports against a resident of Taleigao in connection with a major employment fraud case. The suspect allegedly cheated job seekers under the pretext of securing government positions.

headline: Kejriwal announces six guarantees for Goa ahead of polls
summary: AAP leader Arvind Kejriwal has unveiled six major election guarantees for Goa, including promises of free electricity and monthly financial aid for women. The announcements aim to showcase the party's vision for the state.

headline: AAP promises free power and women's aid in Goa
summary: Arvind Kejriwal has rolled out six poll guarantees for Goa, prominently featuring free electricity and a monthly allowance for women. These promises form the core of AAP's pitch to voters in the upcoming elections.

headline: Kejriwal outlines AAP's vision with six Goa guarantees
summary: During his visit, Arvind Kejriwal presented six key guarantees to give voters a glimpse of governance under the Aam Aadmi Party in Goa. The pledges include welfare measures like financial assistance and utility subsidies.

headline: Goa Police register unnatural death case for Nana Patekar

summary: Goa Chief Minister Pramod Sawant expressed deep grief over the death of veteran actor Nana Patekar. He called the demise a big loss for the entire country.

summary: Medical professionals and late-night messages have shed light on the final hours before veteran actor Nana Patekar suffered a fatal cardiac arrest in Goa. Doctors confirmed he experienced pain on the left side before passing away.

summary: A special PMLA court in Goa has ordered the framing of formal charges in the multi-crore Yudivo multi-level marketing scam. The financial fraud case involves extensive money laundering allegations.

summary: The National Green Tribunal has placed a stay on the environmental clearance granted for the Mormugao Port Authority's channel-deepening project. The decision halts further development work pending further review.

summary: Goa Chief Minister Pramod Sawant stated that the party high command will determine the leadership for the 2027 assembly elections. He emphasized that his current primary duty is to secure electoral victories.

summary: Footage of veteran actor Nana Patekar cheerfully playing the shamel and dancing at an event in Goa just days before his death has emerged online. The video has been widely shared by grieving fans.

summary: Goa Chief Minister Pramod Sawant has formally paid tribute to the late actor Nana Patekar, acknowledging his immense contribution to Indian cinema. Sawant highlighted the actor's impactful work and legacy.

headline: A look at veteran actor Nana Patekar's assets and net worth
summary: Following the passing of veteran actor Nana Patekar at 75, reports have highlighted his notable assets, including properties in Mumbai and Goa, along with his career earnings.

summary: Veteran actor Nana Patekar's final public appearance took place at an event in Goa just four days prior to his sudden death. He was most recently seen on screen in the film 'O'Romeo'.

summary: Goa Police stated that actor Nana Patekar was brought dead to the hospital after suffering a cardiac arrest. Authorities have registered an unnatural death case as part of standard protocol.

summary: Following Nana Patekar's death in Goa, police registered an unnatural death case and conducted a post-mortem examination at the Goa Medical College. Authorities are investigating the circumstances surrounding the sudden cardiac arrest.

summary: Doctors at Goa's Manipal Hospital have confirmed that veteran actor Nana Patekar passed away due to a sudden cardiac arrest. Medical staff detailed the emergency response following his sudden collapse.

summary: Celebrated Indian actor Nana Patekar has died at the age of 75 during his stay in Goa. Tributes have poured in from leaders and fans mourning the loss of the veteran star.

headline: Actor Nana Patekar dies at 75 after cardiac arrest in Goa
summary: Veteran actor Nana Patekar has passed away at the age of 75 following a fatal cardiac arrest in Goa. The actor was widely celebrated for his decades-long career in Indian cinema.

summary: Veteran actor Nana Patekar was found unconscious at his residence in Goa before being pronounced dead at age 75. The sudden news of his passing has shocked the film fraternity.

summary: Goa police have formally registered an unnatural death case following the sudden passing of actor Nana Patekar. Officials stated that routine investigation procedures are being followed.

summary: In interviews and appearances shortly before his death in Goa, veteran actor Nana Patekar spoke candidly about the inevitability of death. Fans have widely shared these poignant final reflections.

summary: The National Green Tribunal has continued its stay on the Mormugao Port Authority's contentious channel-deepening project. Environmental concerns raised against the dredging work remain under judicial review.

summary: The Goa cabinet has approved several key policy decisions aimed at boosting the tourism sector, enhancing agriculture, and improving urban development across the state.

summary: In the wake of Nana Patekar's sudden death in Goa, industry colleagues have offered heartfelt tributes. Several public events and show premieres have been called off as a mark of respect.

summary: Goa MLA Govind Gaude has assured that the political reservation for the Scheduled Tribe community will be finalized and implemented before November. The announcement comes amid ongoing discussions on community representation.

summary: The High Court has set aside the Goa municipal delimitation notification, citing a lack of meaningful consultation with stakeholders. The ruling mandates a proper review before proceeding with municipal boundaries.

summary: Goa Chief Minister Pramod Sawant has announced that the Mirabag barrage project has been relocated to Panchwadi. The decision follows administrative reviews and local consultations.

summary: The Goa Chamber of Commerce and Industry, along with government and corporate partners, has announced free artificial intelligence training programs for small business owners to boost digital adoption.
